title: Big Bold Menthols Blue Raspberry Menthol 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Big Bold Menthols Nic Salts Blue Raspberry Menthol delivers the perfect balance between sweet and tart blue raspberry and the cooling freshness of menthol. This icy, fruit-forward e-liquid is ideal for vapers who enjoy the vibrant sweetness of berry flavours, paired with a refreshingly crisp menthol exhale, providing a satisfying and invigorating vaping experience. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Big Bold Nic Salts are designed for use with mouth-to-lung (MTL) starter kits and pod devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these nic salts provide smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers looking for a fast, satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco products. If you love this flavour, there are several other flavours to try from Big Bold’s collection, including Menthols, Creamy and Fruity flavours. Explore such beguiling blends as Honey Melon, Banana Milk, and Vanilla Custard for a Big Bold burst of flavour and a taste sensation like no other.
